_comment: R58.2 (2026-09-03): Phase 1.3 hardware preset for RTX 40xx 24GB VRAM (RTX 4080/4090). Large VRAM enables full GPU offload for most 7B-13B models. 70B partial offload possible but slow.

_hardware.name: RTX 40xx 24GB
_hardware._4080_note: RTX 4080 has 16GB (not 24GB). 24GB tier is for 4090/4090 D only.

_model_recommendations._comment: At 24GB VRAM, full offload works for 7B-13B (Q4_K_M). 70B fits with partial offload (slow).
_model_recommendations._recommendation: Q4_K_M or Q5_K_M for 7B-13B, Q4_K_M for 70B+.

cppworker._gpu_layers_note: 99 = all layers on GPU (no CPU offload for typical 7B-13B)
cppworker._kv_cache_note: F16 KV cache at 24GB — 7B-13B fits comfortably. 70B+ may need Q8 KV.

ram_fallback._comment: Less aggressive than 8GB preset — most models fit at 24GB.

balancer._comment: Default balancer settings work — large VRAM means prefill is fast (~30-60s for 7B).
